title: Wiki & Knowledge Core
selected_by_owner: 2026-10-04 owner explicitly approved CWKS-07 Wiki & Knowledge Core as the next non-AI CWKS tranche and authorized continuation through the normal design/planning/implementation process; artifact-specific review gates remain enforced.
objective: Design and implement the non-AI CWKS Wiki & Knowledge Core over published CreatorDocumentV1 documents: stable wiki page/catalog identity, project/library scope, [[link]] resolution to stable page references, aliases/tags, deterministic derived backlinks, live transclusion, local persistence/recovery and an accessible reusable Wiki workspace without absorbing WCI or CSW/D29 authority.

include: wiki catalog/page identity with pageId -> documentId association
stable [[Title]] and [[Title|Label]] authoring resolution to existing cwks-wiki-page resource mentions
aliases, tags and deterministic metadata lookup
derived outgoing links/backlinks from explicit CWKS document references
live wiki transclusion using existing resource-embed mode=live with cycle/missing protection
provider-neutral local Wiki Catalog persistence/autosave/recovery with stale-write protection
accessible reusable Wiki workspace and editor integration
focused governed Linux/Windows deterministic validation and sealed predecessor regressions
exclude: AI writing, generation, critique, rewriting, summarization or AI context
WCI canonical entity mutation or permission/visibility authority
CSW Story Bible, CreativeFragment or Project Memory provenance authority
collaborative editing, comments or named version-history UI
Story Project corkboard, storyboard, timeline or plot-board views
GPR Session Service or CASI semantic-appearance implementation
